analysis: The PR is documentation-only: docs/architecture/inference.md (new paragraph at head lines 1118-1128 and a failure-mode row at line 1517) and docs/reference/qwen4-next-support.md (date bump plus a sentence extending the reasoning-effort validation boundary to Qwen3.8-27B builds). No code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation, or cache-storage behavior changes, so no finding is warranted. The docs describe pre-request validation of unsupported reasoning efforts (`low`/`medium`/`xhigh` only while thinking is enabled) as a typed HTTP 400 `client_error`. They also say media preparation rethrows typed request errors instead of wrapping them as a retryable 503. The text reads as input validation that reduces provider-fault 500 classification, which is neutral to favorable for the TB-002 availability/DoS posture and T-008. It does not touch the T-041 prefix-cache or A-001 confidentiality assumptions. One unverified contract: the referenced code (`Qwen4SupportPolicy.validateReasoningContext`, media-preparation rethrow, `ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs`) was not in the supplied evidence, so I could not confirm the docs match the implementation. The docs also say the typed 400 is content-free for the caller. A reviewer of the code change should confirm that the error text does not echo prompt content and that the validation runs before any cache lookup or submission. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of a defect.
